key_insight: SQuAT improves low-bit LLM quantization-aware training by separating weight direction and magnitude, with distinct gradient estimators that induce tangent-space updates for directions.
engineering_relevance: Distributed exact nearest-neighbor assignment reduces VQ-QAT training time by 12.8×, enabling training runs of up to 10 billion tokens.
method: Decompose weight vectors into normalized directions and scalar gains.
Quantize directions with an E8-derived spherical codebook and gains with low-bit scalar quantizers, using separate straight-through estimators.
Distribute assignment across disjoint weight blocks and communicate only discrete indices.
evidence_signal: Across instruction-tuned LLaMA-3.2-1B/3B and Qwen3-4B, plus base Qwen3-1.7B, SQuAT consistently outperforms standard VQ-QAT STE with identical quantizers and initialization.
watch_item: The abstract does not report absolute accuracy gains, hardware requirements, or inference speedups, limiting deployment-level conclusions.
paper_title: SQuAT: Spherical Lattice Vector Quantization-Aware Training
